export_evidence: Company website homepage: "80+ Countries Machines running across the world" and "Worldwide Shipping Air & sea · request an export quote". No bill-of-lading number, no shipment date, no destination-specific record and no HS code line was found. importkey.com/countries/india/cruxweld-industrial-equipments-pvt-ltd returned only a generic template shell ("Loading...", "Shipments available for CRUXWELD INDUSTRIAL EQUIPMENTS PVT LTD, refreshed daily") with 0 actual shipment rows rendered; volza.com and trademo.com returned HTTP 403; eximpedia returned HTTP 403. Source counter: 1 importkey page opened, 0 shipment rows seen.
domestic_evidence: Company website clients page (cruxweld.com/clients/): "170+ Organisations listed here" and "The organisations below have purchased Cruxweld equipment directly or received it on their projects through contractors and channel partners." The page lists 36 government/PSU/defence organisations (ONGC, IOCL, BHEL, SAIL, Indian Navy, DRDO etc.) but gives no PO number, contract value, tender reference, GST turnover figure or date. No GeM/CPPP tender award record was retrieved. GST turnover band: null (not public in retrieved sources).
note: Legal entity exists and operates a live website (cruxweld.com, footer: '© 2026 Cruxweld Industrial Equipments Pvt. Ltd.'), self-described as 'GeM Registered OEM Manufacturer' and 'ISO 9001 Certified'. Declared HS codes 851531/851539/851580 (arc welding machinery) are consistent with the actual product range (MIG/TIG/ARC welders, SAW, welding automation), so no HS correction is needed. However, per Rule 5, no factual shipment evidence was obtained for either channel: no customs/B-L record with date, destination and HS code, and no GST turnover, GeM/CPPP award or contract document. The '80+ countries' and '170+ organisations' figures are self-published marketing claims and are recorded as 'заявлено, не подтверждено'. Search engines were unavailable/blocked during this run (DuckDuckGo connection refused, Google 429, Bing returned irrelevant results), so the absence of records is partly a tooling limitation, not proof of no shipments — status is declared_only rather than none_found. Revenue and export volume: null (not public in retrieved sources). No rejection grounds: entity is active, not struck off or bankrupt.
